english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when explaining that language should not be understood literally.

examples.english: When I say “I’m freezing cold,” it’s figurative, not that I’m really turning to ice.
examples.traditional: 我講「凍到結冰」只係唔係字面意思嘅講法，唔係真係結冰。
